article.story: LOUISVILLE, Ky. -- — Dallas Howell scored 24 points as North Alabama beat Bellarmine 82-73 on Saturday. Howell finished 8 of 9 from 3-point range for the Lions (6-9, 1/3 Atlantic Sun Conference). Corneilous Williams scored 20 points while going 7 of 12 and 6 of 9 from the free-throw line and added 15 rebounds. Canin Jefferson had 17 points and shot 5 for 12 (1 for 6 from 3-point range) and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. The Lions stopped a five-game skid with the victory. Brian Waddell led the Knights (6-10, 1-3) in scoring, finishing with 20 points. Jack Karasinski added 17 points and six rebounds for Bellarmine. Kenyon Goodin also recorded 17 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
